turns.content: For total cobalt concentration 10^-2 M, free ligand L=[SCN-]=0.1 M, and cumulative constants beta1=9, beta2=40, beta3=63, beta4=16, write the complex-formation expressions and cobalt mass balance including free Co2+.
Derive the distribution fraction of cobalt present as the dithiocyanato complex Co(SCN)2.
Evaluate each beta_n L^n contribution and state the numerator and denominator for the Co(SCN)2 fraction.
Calculate the percentage of all cobalt-containing species present as Co(SCN)2.
Verify that the free-ion and four complex fractions sum to one.
Explain why the supplied beta values are cumulative rather than stepwise formation constants in this calculation.
Report the final percentage of cobalt present as Co(SCN)2 and state the normalization over free Co2+ and the four complexes.
